image_description: A side-profile view of a large, dark brown bison walking on a gravelly bank near water. A second bison is partially visible in the background to the left. The main subject displays a prominent shoulder hump, shaggy forequarters, and a darker, less furry hindquarter. The head is lowered slightly, showing a beard and short horns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile. It is large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are distinctly visible protruding from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though resolution limits detailed iris inspection, it matches the 'dark' description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and are largely obscured by the thick fur of the head and poll, matching the biological trait.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The withers (shoulder area) are significantly higher than the hips, creating the characteristic sloping back of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a very clear textural difference between the front and back. The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur that forms a high, rounded hump.
The rear half of the body has visibly shorter, smoother hair compared to the mane and shoulder hump, exposing the underlying muscle shape more clearly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are small and curved, appearing proportionally short against the massive scale of the head and body.
The visible legs are thick and sturdy. The hooves are dark and appear solid. While 'cloven' detail is hard to see at this resolution, the general shape and sturdiness match the checkpoint.
The tail is visible hanging down behind the hind legs. It is relatively short and ends in a darker, bushy switch/tuft.

artifact_observations.location: Fur texture on the flank and hindquarters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fur on the mid-section and hindquarters appears somewhat smudged or painterly rather than having distinct individual hairs, which is common in AI generation but also possible in low-res photography. It lacks the crispness of the shoulder fur.

The front left leg (closest to viewer) seems to merge slightly with the ground or the other leg at the hoof level. The definition of the hoof is soft and lacks clear separation from the gravel, suggesting slight melting or grounding issues.
The second bison in the background blends into the first one slightly at the edges, and its form is somewhat indistinct, which could be depth-of-field blur or AI blending artifacts.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the species identification and rule out hybrid or misclassified bovids.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the spine alignment, ensuring no extra limbs or impossible joint angles.
To check for edge bleeding between the shaggy fur and the background, and to ensure the 'melting' observed in the legs is not a topological error.
To assess if the texture smudging is due to compression/artifacts or generative failure.

focus_areas: Leg-hoof grounding and separation from the ground plane.
Transition zone between shaggy forequarter fur and smooth hindquarter fur.
Structural correctness of the shoulder hump and spine slope.
Edge sharpness of the beard and horns against the background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the front legs. The Router noted potential merging/melting at the hooves. Verify if this is a true artifact or just shadow/low-resolution blur. Also, evaluate if the fur texture consistency is realistic for a photograph of this apparent age/quality.
